entities.summary: The Környe–Oroszlány railway line is a 7.1 kilometres (4.4 mi) railway line in Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary. The line runs between Környe and Oroszlány, connecting with the Tatabánya–Pápa railway line at Környe. It is owned and operated by Hungarian State Railways (MÁV) and primarily serves passenger traffic between Tatabánya and Oroszlány
